note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. One tag row (focusTarget) changes from beforeValue to afterValue; the old value stays traceable and seeking back restores it. Nothing is inferred about validity, admissibility or custody. Stress record values are capped so every row fits inside the magnified tag at >= 16 px; all are at least as long as the baseline. Editable brief fields: items, custodians, timestamps, records, focusTarget, beforeValue, afterValue, detailGeometry, contextLabels. Coordinator decision (standing rule 2026-09-26, from LAW-0687/0689-0692): the long-labels-stress record values and afterValue are capped to the longest values that fit the magnified tag at >= 16 px in 1:1 after the fallback layouts (side panels 0.36-0.48, two-column panel below, four lens splits) were tried; every value stays longer than the baseline's.
